description: This file contains enum definitions and utility functions for managing and referencing different AI providers, including mappings, logos, and model retrieval logic.

methods.name: getProviderLogoAndName
methods.description: Returns the logo URL and display name for a given provider value, with special handling for 'gemini'.

methods.name: getPlaceholder
methods.description: Provides a placeholder string based on the selected provider, often indicating a default or example model.

methods.name: getProviderModels
methods.description: Filters models from a provided model map based on the selected provider, including special handling for Cohere and SageMaker.
